speaker: jacqueline_field
text: Cloak. The pages inside it, the writing in. I have seen enough edges for one night. The cups stay on the oak until the door is actually shut behind you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: In. The same fold. I am not leaving a leaf on the settle to be kinder than a closed packet.

speaker: richard_field
text: One lantern, when we are at the door. It is on the bracket. I am not lighting it to make a ceremony of a lane. A lane, and then thy own dark.

speaker: jacqueline_field
text: Take the lane when it is offered, and do not bargain it into a street.
